title: Netscape Navigator 3.04
note: Archived 32-bit Windows standard installer.

title: Netscape Navigator 4.08
note: Archived 32-bit Windows standalone browser; 40-bit edition.

title: Netscape Communicator 4.8
note: Archived 32-bit Windows complete suite installer.

title: Windows 95 Winsock 2 update
note: Archived networking update for Windows 95; not for Windows 98/NT.

title: Windows 95 Dial-Up Networking 1.4
note: Archived Windows 95 dial-up networking update. Save your current networking settings first.

title: Windows 95 Year 2000 update
note: Historical date and leap-year fixes for Windows 95. Read the installation notes: the package may prompt to install Internet Explorer components.

title: DCOM95 1.3
note: DCOM runtime for Windows 95 applications that require it. Windows 95 only; use the appropriate DCOM package for other operating systems.

title: Windows 95 OLE 32 update
note: Historical OLE2 document handling, file-system consistency and stability update for Windows 95. Check existing component versions before installing.

title: Windows 95 DOS device-name fix (Q256015)
note: English Windows 95 / OSR2 fix for crashes caused by multiple reserved MS-DOS device names in a path. Not the Windows 98 package.

title: Windows 95 IP fragment reassembly fix (MS00-029)
note: Historical Windows 95 patch for malformed IP fragment reassembly denial of service. English package; read the bulletin for applicability.

title: Windows 95 AMD K6-2 timing update
note: For the documented Windows 95 timing-loop problem on high-speed AMD K6-2 systems. This is a targeted fix, not a general CPU driver.

title: Microsoft PowerToys for Windows 95
note: Original Windows 95 productivity utilities. Extract to a folder and read the included README/INF instructions; unrelated to modern PowerToys.

title: Microsoft Kernel Toys for Windows 95
note: Windows 95 utilities including Process Watcher, keyboard tools and Time Zone Editor. Microsoft described these as unsupported tools, not for Windows 98.

title: ListPCI 1.03 - ready-to-run DOS utility
note: Download this EXE directly; no ZIP extractor needed. Restart Windows 95 in MS-DOS mode, run LISTPCI, or use LISTPCI > PCIIDS.TXT to save a report. Shows PCI vendor and device IDs.

title: ListPCI 1.03 - complete package and source
note: Official FreeDOS ZIP containing the same EXE, README and C source (GPLv2). The EXE is in BIN/LISTPCI.EXE. Run in DOS; /C 2 filters network controllers.

title: MT9234ZPX experimental V1 - reported settings crash
note: Superseded by the standard-UI V2 test below. User reported a BBEPORT.DLL GPF and a busy port after reboot with V1. Retained for reference; do not reinstall V1.

title: MT9234ZPX / Exar - standard-UI test V2
note: Targets the reported BBEPORT.DLL settings crash by using Windows SERIALUI.DLL. Same original Win9x VxDs, matched to 13A8:0152; no B&B DLL included. Read README.TXT for updating the COM port. Win95 stability and post-reboot operation are NOT verified.

title: USRobotics Windows 95 modem INF collection
note: Courier V.90/x2, legacy Courier and older Sportster INFs with installation notes. Older Sportster INF is not for 56K models. No firmware or Winmodem drivers.

title: USRobotics Courier V.Everything V.90/x2 INF
note: Windows 95/NT4 modem information file extracted from the archived 1998 Courier package. Match the exact Courier model; does not upgrade modem firmware.

title: USRobotics legacy Courier INF
note: Legacy Courier models; use the V.90 INF for Courier V.90/x2 models. Extracted from the archived 1998 Courier package.

title: USRobotics older Sportster INF
note: 1995-era Windows 95 Sportster modem definitions. Not for 56K Sportsters or Winmodems; choose the matching model.

title: Internet Explorer 4.01 SP2 - full offline installer (English)
note: English archived full setup with Windows 95 and NT4 payloads. Self-extract to a folder, then run IE4SETUP.EXE inside IE4SETUP. Includes Windows Desktop Update, which changes the Windows shell. Installation on this PC has not been tested.

title: Winamp 2.91 (full)
note: Nullsoft Winamp 2.91 full installer, from the last 2.x line that runs on Windows 95. Plays MP3, WAV, MIDI, CD audio and SHOUTcast streams; skins are compatible with classic 2.x skins. Version identified by the archive filename (the installer is compressed).

title: Windows Media Player 6.4 (6.4.05.0803)
note: Original Windows Media Player 6.4 setup for Windows 95/98/NT 4. Setup refuses to run without Internet Explorer 4.0 or later; IE 4.01 SP2 is in the Browsers section. Newer WMP 7+ releases do not support Windows 95.

title: Windows Media Player 6.4 later build (6.4.07.1110)
note: Later 6.4 component setup carrying updated DirectShow files. Its license names Windows 95 and 98, but the archive filename suggests a Windows 98 release; if it will not install, use the 6.4.05 build above.

title: Windows Media Player 6.4 security update (KB828026)
note: Microsoft update 6.4.7.1128 replacing msdxm.ocx for Windows Media Player 6.4 (MS04-005 era). Install after Media Player 6.4.

title: Windows Media 8 codecs for Media Player 6.4
note: Codec pack 8.0.0.4487 adding Windows Media Audio/Video 8 and MPEG-4 decoders so Media Player 6.4 can play later WMA and WMV files.
